the captured home trust bar is made of live receipts (conformance 40/40 links to the harness, Apache-2.0 is the license, latency links to benchmarks). brand_faithful_inversions: Color tokens retained in hex format (matches captured brand surface and DESIGN.md Stitch frontmatter convention). OKLCH applies to new authoring; this is inheritance.
Saturated #00E599 retained as the primary brand color (existing canonical accent of fold.run). The agent-default reflex toward tinted-neutral primaries is inverted per brand-faithful direction.

#ffffff (Paper) retained as the docs light-theme ground (existing Starlight decision; unified layer restyles hues/type, not the light ground). The 'no pure white' rule is inverted per brand-faithful direction.

Up #00E599 / Down #ff4c79 retained as reserved colors for live status semantics only (existing /status decision). The agent-default reflex to spread accents across the system is inverted; see divergence-toolkit § color reservation.
